answers.name: AI P2 · UX and product management graduate student, new to cloud

background.product: I use a MacBook every day along with Google Docs, Sheets, and Figma for design work. When building prototype websites for class or side projects, I use VS Code and lean heavily on AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude to help me write code.
background.work: I'm a graduate student in UX design and product management, so most of my experience is in design sprints, user research projects, and university group work. In my internships, I helped map out user journeys and run usability tests, but I haven't worked with company infrastructure or production cloud setups.
background.study: I have taken courses in UX design, interaction design, product management, and introductory statistics for user research. I've watched a few high-level YouTube videos explaining what cloud computing is, but I've never taken formal cloud courses or studied cloud billing.
background.life: I keep track of my monthly living expenses and tuition using a personal Google Sheet and checking my bank app regularly. I like to set personal spending caps each month so I don't go over budget.

answers.careText: I'd worry about accidentally setting the budget to include other projects by mistake, or misconfiguring the alert so an unexpected huge charge happens without anyone being notified.
